content.short: Enjin is an NFT-focused metaverse platform that enables users to create, trade, distribute, and integrate NFTs across games and applications.
content.description: Enjin is an NFT-focused platform that enables users to create, trade, distribute, and integrate non-fungible tokens across games and applications. The platform serves businesses, individuals, and developers, and comprises a marketplace, a minting platform, a wallet, and software development kits (SDKs) to support NFT-enabled experiences for developers, creators, and enterprises. Enjin has also developed Efinity, a Polkadot parachain dedicated to NFTs.
